main_body: three-story brick campus building with a green tiled/copper roof
top_band: grey parapet and green copper/tile roof surface with rooftop vents from rows 1 to 40
evidence: Rows 1-40 show a foreshortened rooftop enclosed by a grey parapet (with an inner shadow at rows 4-5) and a green tiled surface with 3/4 rooftop vents. Below the front parapet edge (rows 38-40) is a cream cornice (41-45), eave shadow/trim, and the three-story brick front facade (rows 41-143) with recessed windows and arched doorway.

style.evidence: While the 3/4 construction is solid, the pixel art relies on very mechanical, repetitive stamps compared to the Beodeul reference buildings. The brick wall uses a rigid, uniform 2-3 tone grid pattern, the 28 windows are identical copy-pasted blocks, and the green roof uses a flat repetitive tile stamp lacking the rich 5-6 step directional light ramp and organic hand-placed variation of the reference roofs and stone walls.
